title: Prism-1: Position- and Rival-Independent Scoring for System One Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given a state and a set of options, such as intents, tools or interface elements, System One decision models return a distribution over the options in one forward pass, without generated reasoning. Web systems increasingly build them by reading decisions from language models. Two axioms of rational choice are natural requirements for such decisions, because in web systems the listing and the option set are determined by other components and can change or be manipulated: the order in which the options are listed should not matter, and adding an option should not change the relative odds of the others (Luce's choice axiom). translated_title: Prism-1：面向系统1模型的位置无关与竞争者无关的评分方法
translated_abstract: 给定一个状态和一组选项（例如意图、工具或界面元素），系统1决策模型在一次前向传播中返回选项上的分布，无需生成推理过程。Web系统越来越多地通过从语言模型中读取决策来构建此类模型。理性选择的两条公理是这类决策的天然要求，因为在Web系统中，选项的列出方式和选项集合由其他组件决定，可能发生变化或被操纵：选项列出的顺序不应产生影响，添加一个选项不应改变其他选项之间的相对几率（Luce选择公理）。我们测试了标准的读取方式，即单选题（SCQ）提示，包括乱序训练、顺序平均或排序选项，以及不变集合架构，发现每一种都至少违反一条公理：一次打乱会改变12-20%的SCQ答案，排序只是冻结了任意的约定，而一个良好的……
tldr: 论文提出了Prism-1，一种面向系统1决策模型的评分方法，可同时满足位置无关性与Luce选择公理（竞争者无关性），克服了现有标准SCQ读取方式违反理性选择公理的缺陷。
en_tdlr: Prism-1 is a scoring method for System One decision models that satisfies both position independence and Luce's choice axiom (rival independence), addressing the axiom violations found in standard single-choice question reads.
